description: Landa imodeli eyonconyiwe ukuze uqale ukuxoxa, noma bheka i-Hub ukuze uthole enye.
checkEngineGpuUnused: {{backend}} yakhiwe kuphela ku CPU, ngakho-ke {{gpus}} izohlala ingenzi lutho. Khetha i-GPU backend ku-Settings ukuyisebenzisa.
checkEngineVendorMismatch: {{backend}} idinga {{vendor}} GPU, kodwa Novera ithole {{gpus}}. Novera izosebenza ku CPU.
checkEngineRuntimeUnreachable: {{backend}} ayikwazi ukufinyelela ku-GPU yakho, ngakho-ke Novera izosebenza ku CPU. Lokhu kuvame ukusho ukuthi umshayeli noma i-runtime ye-GPU idinga ukuvuselelwa.
checkEngineMissingLibrary: {{backend}} ayikwazi ukuqala ngoba ulayibrari odingekayo ulahlekile ({{libraries}}), ngakho-ke Novera izosebenza ku CPU.
checkEngineProbeFailed: Akukwazi ukuqinisekisa ukuthi i-engine ingasebenzisa i-GPU yakho
checkEngineUnavailable: Lolu hlobo lwe-engine alukwazi ukubika isimo se-GPU
checkSearchNoVector: Imodeli yokufaka ayikaphumi umphumela, ngakho usesho lwamafayela alusasebenzi okwamanje
checkSearchInvalidVector: Imodeli yokufaka ibuyisele umphumela ongasebenziseki, ngakho usesho lwamafayela kungenzeka lungatholi lutho
checkSearchUnavailable: Le build yinjini ayikwazi ukuqinisekisa imodeli yokufaka
welcomeBody: Lokhu kuthatha imizuzu embalwa: Novera ilanda injini yayo yokucabanga nemodeli encane yokusesha amafayela. Ungaqhubeka usebenzisa ikhompyutha yakho ngenkathi isebenza.
dsparkDescription: Landa ifayela elisizayo le-DSpark Q8_0 ({{size}}) le-LFM2.5-2.6B. Lingase lisheshise ukukhiqizwa kwezimpendulo, kodwa lisebenzisa i-RAM noma i-VRAM eyengeziwe, kushiye inkumbulo encane yomongo. Lihlole kuhadiwe yakho; lungisa ubude bomongo noma uvale i-speculative decoding kuzilungiselelo zemodeli.
